description:
SpaceCloud Global helps you find and book rental spaces internationally — meeting rooms, photo and video studios, coworking offices, and event venues. Describe what you need in natural language
  (location, date, time, capacity), and SpaceCloud Global returns a ranked list of matching spaces with photos, pricing, amenities, and direct booking links on spacecloud.city. Currently available
   in the United Kingdom and Ireland, with additional countries being added on an ongoing basis.
